title: Candidate Not Asset
intent: Keep reviewed candidates distinct from owned or production assets.
problem: Without separate status types prohibit candidate-to-owned coercion, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the candidate not asset contract.
context: This pattern addresses learning outputs await rights and quality review; its concrete control is separate status types prohibit candidate-to-owned coercion.
forces: Correctness requires that review approval does not establish ownership
Operational pressure can cause: generic strings bypass typed status checks
solution: Implement separate status types prohibit candidate-to-owned coercion. Verify the anchored symbol `AssetPromotionDenied` with `test_asset_must_advance_sequentially` before reuse.
invariants: review approval does not establish ownership
registry accepts only declared promotion outcomes
failure_modes: generic strings bypass typed status checks
UI labels imply ownership absent legal evidence
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `generic strings bypass typed status checks` and fails closed if the candidate not asset evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For candidate not asset, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to separate status types prohibit candidate-to-owned coercion.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: learning outputs await rights and quality review
Do not apply when: the artifact was authored and registered through the owned-asset process
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: learning outputs await rights and quality review
not_when: the artifact was authored and registered through the owned-asset process
